title: Velocity.
officialText:
The minimum average velocity through a fixed opening shall not be less than: v = 217.2 [h (T - T )/(T + 460)]1/ (Equation 9-2) f o f 2
For SI: v = 119.9 [h (T - T )/T ]1/ f o f 2

where:

h = Height of opening, feet (m).

T = Temperature of smoke, °F (°K). f

T = Temperature of ambient air, °F (°K). o

v = Air velocity, feet per minute (m/minute).
